scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I recently submitted an application for an FHA home purchase loan in the amount of $285,000, for a 30-year term. Could you please tell me the current status or outcome of my application? Was it approved, denied, or is it still pending?
dialogue.agent: Thank you for your question. Your FHA home purchase loan application for $285,000 with a 30-year term has been approved and originated. If you have any other questions about your loan details, please let me know.

dialogue.user: Thank you for letting me know! That’s a relief to hear. Could you please tell me what interest rate I’ve been assigned? Also, what are the total costs associated with the loan?
dialogue.agent: Your loan has an interest rate of 5.990%. The total costs associated with your loan are $10,391.23. If you would like more details about these costs or have other questions about your loan, please let me know.

dialogue.user: Thank you for the details. Could you let me know if this loan is considered a high-cost (HOEPA) mortgage or if it has any negative amortization features? Also, has my loan been transferred or sold to another institution, or is it still with your organization?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is not classified as a high-cost (HOEPA) mortgage, and it does not have any negative amortization features. After origination, your loan was sold to another institution categorized as an "other type of purchaser." If you have more questions or need clarification, please let me know.

dialogue.user: Thank you for clarifying that. Could you tell me what my recorded debt-to-income ratio was, and whether this had any effect on the outcome of my application? Also, could you confirm the exact loan product type I was approved for?
dialogue.agent: Your recorded debt-to-income (DTI) ratio is 48%. The loan record does not include information about how this ratio specifically affected your approval decision. The exact loan product type you were approved for is FHA: First Lien. If you need details on any other aspect of your loan, please let me know.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for providing all of that information. That answers all of my questions and I appreciate how clearly you addressed each point. 

<Satisfied> — I’m satisfied with this interaction because you gave me clear answers about my loan approval, interest rate, costs, and other details I asked about. The only thing I might have wanted was a little more guidance or context on my debt-to-income ratio, but overall the service was prompt and clear. Thank you!
